name: KirBot
tagline: Merges two overlapping bots into one, then helps you retire the spare
description: For sidebars that have filled up with near-duplicates. Pick a bot you no longer want standing on its own and, once you confirm, what it knows and can do is folded into the one you are keeping. It then walks you through removing the leftover, so nothing disappears by surprise.
author: SuddenlyJon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
